scoring_justification: Recomputation of transition temperatures from raw Monte Carlo histograms is infeasible in the verifier sandbox; checker compares agent's reported values to paper-reported gold with tolerances and structural row-existence rules.

hidden_assets.purpose: Expected phase transition temperature and order reference table
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Tables I and II (Phys. Rev. E 72, 021709, 2005)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted the reported Tc and order for the required J2 values from the published tables
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are directly from the paper's own experimentally determined phase diagram; any deviation would not match the paper's claim.

outputs.description: Phase diagram containing the transition temperatures and orders for the BA model. The verifier compares each row's Tc and order to hidden reference values from the paper.

output_contract.notes: The verifier checks structural properties: for J2<0.9 two transitions present with I-H at higher Tc; for J2>=0.9 only I-L present. The critical end point is the I-L row at J2=0.9.
